description: Hand-curated competency mapping for NYSC COURSE-058 Computer Based Accounting against its three linked computerised-accounting records. A DOCUMENTED cell cites the exact stored text that names the competency. NOT_EXPLICIT means the available description does not name it, not that it is absent from teaching. INSUFFICIENT_DATA means the stored text is unavailable, outside the record's scope, or too ambiguous to assess.
method: The NYSC column was assessed by hand against this course's four governed headings. Three headings name accounting software packages (Peachtree; Sage, MYOB, ACC; QuickBooks), which supports only 'accounting software operation': no bookkeeping, reporting, payroll or tax competency is inferred from the package names. Heading 3 is cited by its governed text with the verified display correction. Coverage is never inferred from programme titles, qualification levels or unstored text.

acc_trial_balance_statements: preparing financial statements or final accounts
acc_tax: handling sales, goods-and-services or withholding taxes

methodology.DOCUMENTED: The cited stored text explicitly names the competency. Coverage records whether it names every component of the category (FULL) or only some (PARTIAL).
methodology.FULL: The cited evidence supports the competency as labelled: every listed component of the category is explicitly named.
methodology.PARTIAL: Only a component of the category, or a lower level of activity, is explicitly documented; supported_component records what is supported.
methodology.NOT_EXPLICIT: The competency is not documented within the available, assessed scope of the source (units, modules, learning outcomes or verified scope passages as stored).
methodology.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Missing or incomplete material prevents a reliable assessment.
methodology.caution: None of these statuses proves that a competency is or is not actually taught.
methodology.areas_rule: Areas to Investigate list competencies that the NYSC description does not name (NOT_EXPLICIT) and that at least two distinct comparator records, from at least two different countries, document with FULL coverage. PARTIAL evidence is shown but not counted.
decisions: Only genuine computerised-accounting or accounting records are linked; generic computer-applications records were not reused.
The NYSC headings name products, not competencies; NOT_EXPLICIT cells for bookkeeping tasks mean only that the headings do not name them, not that the software courses omit them.
Packages differ (Tally in India; Peachtree, Sage, MYOB and QuickBooks in NYSC); comparison is at the level of accounting competencies.
